scenarios.name: JOHNSON/SARAH MS
speech: My dog is travelling in the hold today.
Could you confirm that he has been checked in properly?

scenarios.name: SMITH/ALAN MR
speech: I am visually impaired.
Could someone assist me to the departure gate?

scenarios.name: WILSON/EMMA MRS
speech: We are travelling with our six-month-old daughter.
Is it possible to reserve a bassinet?

scenarios.name: LEE/JASON MR
speech: I am hearing impaired.
Could you please provide important announcements in writing?

scenarios.name: MARTINEZ/CARLOS MR
speech: I have been removed from another country.
Airport authorities instructed me to report to your desk.

scenarios.name: DAVIS/THOMAS MR
speech: I am escorting a deportee on today's flight.
All required documentation is available.

scenarios.name: BROWN/MICHAEL MR
speech: I am travelling under the supervision of immigration authorities.
I am not accompanied by an escort.

scenarios.name: CLARK/JAMES MR
speech: I purchased an extra seat for my cello.
Will it be seated next to me during the flight?

scenarios.name: WHITE/PETER MR
speech: Immigration refused my entry upon arrival.
I have been instructed to return on the next available flight.

scenarios.name: THOMPSON/MARY MRS
speech: This is my first time travelling internationally.
Could someone meet and assist me through the airport?

scenarios.name: TAYLOR/LISA MS
speech: I recently had surgery.
My doctor provided documentation stating I am fit to fly.

scenarios.name: JONES/OLIVIA MS
speech: My cat will travel with me in the cabin.
She will remain in her carrier under the seat.

scenarios.name: MILLER/ROBERT MR
speech: I require additional assistance while travelling.
Could you arrange support throughout the airport?

scenarios.name: HARRIS/SUSAN MS
speech: I am travelling with a disability.
Please note my requirements in the reservation.

scenarios.name: WALKER/DAVID MR
speech: I am joining my ship in Singapore tomorrow.
My employer arranged this ticket for me.

scenarios.name: KING/ADAM MR
speech: I have a long layover in Amsterdam.
I will remain in transit and do not require a visa.

scenarios.name: ANDERSON/LUCAS MSTR
speech: I'm travelling to Madrid by myself today.
My parents will meet me at the destination airport.

scenarios.name: GREEN/HELEN MRS
speech: I cannot walk at all.
I require assistance from check-in to my seat on board.

scenarios.name: MOORE/STEPHEN MR
speech: I can walk short distances.
However, I need assistance between the terminal and the aircraft.

scenarios.name: JACKSON/ELLA MS
speech: I am able to walk, but I cannot use stairs.
Will a lift be available for boarding?

scenarios.name: SCOTT/MARK MR
speech: I use an onboard wheelchair during the flight.
Has one been arranged for today's service?

scenarios.name: YOUNG/PATRICIA MRS
speech: My wheelchair is manually operated.
Are there any special handling procedures?

scenarios.name: HALL/GEORGE MR
speech: My wheelchair uses a dry-cell battery.
Are there any restrictions for transporting it?

scenarios.name: ALLEN/KAREN MS
speech: My wheelchair uses a wet-cell battery.
What procedures apply before loading it into the hold?
